blocks.text: Perfectly sized for the busy woman on the run, the Nautica Bean Bag/Belt bag Crossbody Bag gives you everything you’re looking for in a small yet practical daily purse. It is a practical and lightweight bag that lets you to keep your valuable items close by, safe and secure. Our crossbody bag for women is the perfect travel accessory for any lady who is searching for a small, lightweight, and stylish purse. We take pride in making elegant-appearing yet exceptionally functional women’s crossbody bags. This bag is lightweight, fashionable, and easy to clean. It can be used as a daily shoulder bag or a travel bag to anywhere you’re headed. Nautica women’s crossbody bags are easy to use and are offered in a variety of solid colors and prints.

items: NAUTICA BEAN BAG CROSSBODY/BELT BAG FOR WOMEN - Each cross body bag includes, 2 exterior front zipper pocket, 2 Belt loops on the back of the bag to convert to a belt bag , 1 interior zippered pocket an adjustable shoulder strap
CROSSBODY TRAVEL BAG FOR WOMEN - The perfect travel accessory for any women, keep your valuable items close and looking stylish with a Nautica women’s crossbody bag
FASHION & STYLISH – The Bean bag crossbody/belt bag camera comes in an aray of colors with Nautica across the front. There is an option for anyone.
PERFECT SIZE – Not too big and not to small this roomy crossbody purse can carry all your essential items without. SIZE: 9.7" x 7.1" x 2.6"
